source.snippet: AFAIK, despite the agentic push, we just plain cannot use or package Agents using Agent Scripts since Summer '26. Really? I cannot even test our namespaced Agent Actions anymore whether it's a namespaced org or even just packaging those, deploying to non-namespaced org and creating agent there. Same issue. This Known Issue is why. The workaround is stupid and plain doesn't work.

problem_statement: Salesforce ISV developers building managed packages cannot package, deploy, or test Agentforce Agent Actions in namespaced orgs since Summer '26, blocking their ability to ship AI-enabled products to AppExchange customers.
target_segment: Salesforce ISV developers and AppExchange partners building managed packages with Agentforce / AI agent features
notes: Clear business blocker for paid ISV products — AppExchange partners pay Salesforce for partner licenses and earn revenue from managed packages. The frustration is about inability to ship a product, not a hobbyist concern. Potential opportunity: tooling, consultancy, or workaround automation that bridges the packaging gap while Salesforce fixes the known issue. Single post but high commercial stakes per affected party.
